Fleet architecture (0xKK protocol) enables task-appropriate deployment across Heavy/Shadow/Coder roles. Doctrine supports parallel operations without central control.
Existential alignment with fleet's core tenets: mutualism, decentralized command, and iterative improvement. Slot allocation reflects these principles.

Shadow slot represents 'tactical speed' without compromising Heavy's depth
